1418-2226-4518.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-2226-4518.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

955-985-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-2999.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2511-2999.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7745.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Agents of HYDRA, adding {C}{C}.
When Agents of HYDRA dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Agents of HYDRA trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Agents of HYDRA from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1394-2060-5147-7038-7704.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doc Samson.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doc Samson.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

1974-2523-2869.description:
Cast Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Quicksilver Gargantuan into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Quicksilver Gargantuan dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Quicksilver Gargantuan that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Quicksilver Gargantuan token instead.
1974-2523-2869.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

3711-4222-4289.description:
Activate Moonfolk Puzzlemaker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2457-4289-4321-5434.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2730-3175-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

323-4681-5170-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5555-6797-7046.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5434-5555-6797-7046.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

147-1638-2060-4029.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Benevolent Hydra.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

141-554-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-554-5686.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

874-2829-2866-4986.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2829-2866-4986.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

645-1267-3908-6798.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-3908-6798.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

465-719-3742-4251-6633.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-719-3742-4251-6633.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

5147-6188-6591--85.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
5147-6188-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out's second ability triggers, untapping Squall and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

394-997-1445-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
394-997-1445-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

225-1170-1418-3389-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1418-3389-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2560-2863-3059.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Xenagos triggers, giving Malignus +X/+X until end of turn, where X is Malignus's power.
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1931-3860-4050-4999.description:
Cast Wild Dogs from your hand or graveyard by paying {G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wild Dogs, adding {G}.
If Wild Dogs was cast from your graveyard, Wild Dogs is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Overwhelming Splendor removing Wild Dogs's cycling ability.
Repeat.

147-2254-4499.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
147-2254-4499.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Songs of the Damned.
Resolve the copy of Songs of the Damned, adding at least {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat from step 2.
If there are at least four creature cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infintie black mana.

91-2290-5112-5284.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
91-2290-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Mairsil dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Gods' Eye, Gate to the Reikai

1636-2098-4039-4474-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Scaretiller.
1636-2098-4039-4474-5077.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Vesuva from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Gods' Eye.
Put Vesuva into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuva triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1625-4475.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least twenty life.
1625-4475.description:
Cast Magister Sphinx by paying {4}{W}{U}{B}.
When Magister Sphinx enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing an opponent with at least twenty life to lose life until their life total is equal to ten.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent targeted by Magister Sphinx in step 1 loses the game due to having zero or less life.

3263-3576-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Vedalken Engineer.
Vedalken Engineer does not have summoning sickness.
3263-3576-4222.description:
Activate Vedalken Engineer by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Vedalken Engineer.
Repeat.
